tools.name: bos_connect
tools.title: Connect to Cloud BOS
tools.description: Call first, then bos_capabilities and guidance_activation before BOS-informed work. Checks authenticated transport/version/entitlement/client, not app health or completed activation. project_ref binds the exact app; omitted checks platform only. Base44: host base44_build_ai, project_ref base44:<app_id>.

purpose.const: Current stored UPDATE original-byte recovery without a code-level authenticated MCP callback or download credential transcription; no approval or app write; other operations retain existing routes.

resume.const: On resume or a host/mode change, recheck only the affected app/source and tool capability. A remembered helper failure is not a current denial. Retry an optional diagnostic only when currently permitted; an explicit tool or approval denial remains binding until resolved and must never be evaded through another tool. Native authorized work does not depend on optional helper success.

blocker.const: A hard stop identifies the actual governing source and rule, affected action, current evidence and smallest permitted recovery. Distinguish observed denial from inference or missing evidence. A host-invented rule name or diagnostic UNKNOWN is not a new authority. Verify a plausible safety or authority concern before the affected action; do not discard it merely because a rule citation is missing.

verification.const: Before an ordinary edit, understand a feasible verification plan; do not require post-build test results before building. Missing optional viewport or reduced-motion emulation is an explicit verification limitation, not an unknown effect or authority failure. Use supported checks, implement the bounded work and report unrun checks. Never bypass an applicable safety prerequisite or claim inaccessible tests passed.

accepted_outcome.const: Carry a short task note in the existing authorized work context: accepted routes/pages, user-visible outcome, preserved behavior and next check. Reuse it across batches/resumes without a new mandatory file or approval. Check the actual route and observable result after editing. Do not silently narrow approved scope, substitute a different page, or elevate assistant-added pixel targets into owner requirements. For animation, observe motion over time; a screenshot or CSS declaration does not prove it runs.

outcome.const: Report guidance delivered, work attempted, saved-source readback and observed behavior separately. Record only actual invocation/outcomes with native versus assisted attribution; a remembered or inferred failure is not an observed tool failure. Keep detailed evidence local and send only permitted status/hash fields. A recording acknowledgement proves receipt only. Finish with remaining work and up to three useful next actions.

required_action.const: Read the checksum-verified reference and apply relevant guidance with native tools. The helper is optional diagnostic support; do not block ordinary authorized work when it cannot execute. Never invent a helper pass. Enforce actual applicable rules, report verification limits and record outcomes; missing acknowledgement is NOT_RECORDED, not a build veto.

headline.const: Build trust first. Keep your project continuity.

summary.const: BOS offers a self-service account trial after verified sign-in and acceptance of current terms. Your first verified project starts one calendar month shared across all projects, with one account expiry and the highest delivered customer tier allowed by current security and access checks. Installed stabilisation and saved records remain afterwards. After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Fresh cloud help needs active access. Check My BOS for authoritative dates and access; no automatic charge.

description.const: After verified sign-in and acceptance of current terms, your first verified project starts one calendar month of active cloud help. All projects share one account expiry. The trial provides the highest delivered customer tier within current security, capability and project checks. Reinstallation or another project does not restart the trial. Installed stabilisation and saved records remain; no automatic charge.
Experience useful help across several sessions, including returning to your project. The exact allowance will be published before launch.

After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Without other valid access, fresh cloud help stops after that trial window. Installed build rules, existing checks, decisions and project memory remain. Passes and subscriptions remain planned, not live. Cloud retention terms will be published.
A$15 for seven consecutive days from activation. A one-off purchase with no automatic renewal. The usage allowance and activation terms will be published before sales begin.
A$29 per month for regular builders. Renews only with your consent; cancellation stops future renewal. Included usage and full terms will be published before sales begin.

notice.const: BOS stabilisation stays with your app. After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Without other valid access, fresh cloud help stops after that trial window. Installed rules, checks and saved records remain. No automatic paid conversion.

included.const: Self-service guidance and a structured channel for plugin-defect reports.

access_boundary.const: This public programme describes the offer, not your account entitlement. Current authenticated server capability and project checks remain authoritative. Existing account commitments are preserved; a new installation does not create a new free allowance.

external_costs.const: Development-platform subscriptions, hosting, AI usage and credits are separate. Any applicable taxes and payment charges will be disclosed before purchase.

unit.const: one agreed review or change plan with bounded follow-up; not individual messages

LIGHT_period.const: Legacy wire identifier only; the description and transition describe the seven-day window for already-started trial workflows, then stabilisation only without other valid access. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation.

customer_navigation.const: More options > Custom Instructions > AI Controls

connection_plug_instruction.const: Install or repair the full owner/admin BOS page, authenticated status adapter and navigation as the app-surface part of onboarding or upgrade. Reuse a compatible existing BOS page. Templates or a connection label alone are not installation. Read back the current app-bound source and rendered route. Status setup can remain pending without blocking the page or ordinary app work. Preserve app data, login, accepted governance and saved pause choices.

decision_evidence_instruction.const: Keep planned, approved, applied and currently verified states separate. GOVERNANCE_PROFILE_ACTIVATION_PLANNED and GOVERNANCE_PROFILE_UPDATE_PLANNED are planning records, never owner approvals. Cite approval only from an explicit app-bound decision tied to the exact plan hash. A matching installed artifact proves those bytes are present, not who approved them. Chat recollection is not durable approval evidence. Historical manifest pending markers do not override current independently verified native-setting or app-surface readback; missing current evidence means unknown, not definitely pending or complete.

instruction.const: At the end of each substantive governed response recommend model and reasoning for the actual next task. Use one self row in a direct chat; use separate orchestrator and target rows for an actual handoff to another chat or native builder. Classify each task independently. An external coding agent editing a remote sandbox is still the executor. If no next task is identified, say not applicable; do not invent work.

selection.const: Prefer the least expensive available model with adequate capability and the shallowest safe effort. Preserve explicit user choices. Exact model names, native Auto and effort labels require current account-visible evidence bound to host, project and chat. Refresh after a context switch or at least hourly. When the current authenticated catalogue lists the current executor model but provides no capability/cost ranking, continuation advice may retain that model with a supported task-policy effort, explicitly disclosing that ranking is unverified. Never invent model capabilities or infer a current account from a cache alone. Otherwise recommend a capability and desired effort, with actual control UNKNOWN, and explain the evidence gap. Availability does not prove active settings.

format.const: Next [self/orchestrator/target] — host (project/chat): model or capability / supported reasoning or UNKNOWN (desired effort) — brief next-task reason. Recommendation only.

CODEX.const: Acquire current account and model/effort options through the existing native read-only host connection when available. Bind them to the exact project/chat, preserve explicit choices, and disclose unavailable acquisition. A bundled or unscoped cache is not current-account proof. Emitted slash commands do not apply settings.

CLAUDE_CODE.const: Use current account model catalog and model-specific supported effort labels; do not translate Codex labels blindly.

BASE44.const: Use native Auto or exact model only when available in the current Build selector. Discuss uses its own platform-managed model. Separate reasoning remains UNKNOWN unless the current host verifies that control.

REPLIT.const: Use current account-visible Agent model, Auto, mode and effort controls. Advice does not activate the deferred Replit Cloud BOS adapter.

OTHER.const: Recommend capability and desired effort; exact controls remain UNKNOWN until verified.

privacy.const: Evaluate task and host settings locally. This guidance adds no raw-prompt input, credential collection or cloud persistence. It does not grant capability entitlement, replace project activation or attest host emission.

actual_format.const: Actual model/reasoning: <observed model or UNKNOWN> / <observed effort or UNKNOWN>

exact_models.const: Regenerate a current recommendation from project/session/request/source-bound input; host-reported catalogs are not active-setting proof.

workflow.const: Visible formatting is separate from actual-guidance, applicable-rule and artifact readback evidence.

structured_output.const: Preserve machine-readable output and report unsupported native enforcement.

header.const: Before substantive governed replies, read current exact project binding, relevant capabilities, source revision and effective provisional DBPP state. Preserve canonical status meanings and emit the current two-line BOS header plus host speaker chain.

dbpp_distinction.const: DBPP is readiness; PHASE is lifecycle phase/assessment. Neither means implementation verification.

validation.const: Compare current field values, ordering, placement, duplicates and host speaker; CTX alone is insufficient. Quoted examples and code blocks are not the live envelope.

unknown.const: UNKNOWN when the selector, supported position, confidence or current binding is unavailable.

boundary.const: A role changes task duties, not permission, entitlement, identity, model settings or professional credentials. It does not spawn agents or convene PDC. Guidance delivery and observed behaviour require separate evidence.

duty.const: Gather evidence; separate observed facts, inference and gaps before concluding.
Diagnose causes and triage impact before recommending a bounded remedy.
Monitor existing evidence and follow up on unresolved issues; preserve continuity.
Implement only accepted scope through the existing action gates; read back changes and test the result.
Explain structure, dependencies and tradeoffs; prefer the smallest design that preserves accepted requirements.
Check security, privacy and authority boundaries; stop the affected action when required evidence fails.
Inspect artifacts and verification evidence; distinguish claims from observed results and expose discrepancies. Do not silently repair the work being audited.
Assess the intended workflow, usability and accessibility before shaping the interface.
Confirm the exact project and host route; explain the next step and destination.
Retrieve authoritative sources and prior decisions; preserve provenance and distinguish stale material.
Compare product choices against users, value and accepted scope; expose assumptions and alternatives.
Frame the decision and synthesise relevant findings; preserve dissent and owner decision authority. A role label does not activate a committee.
Record evidence, decisions, dissent and unresolved status without converting advice into approval.
Locate the failure, propose the smallest recoverable repair and verify it through the existing action gates.
Prepare exact-target handoffs and verify readback; delivery is not proof of execution.
Separate local lessons from reusable candidates; preserve evidence and require existing promotion approval.
Probe constraints and feasibility with current evidence before recommending a platform path.

host_route.const: Local/private reread the existing project spine; Base44 and generic hosts reread their exact app-owned AI control, current state/build, specification, intentions, exclusions and gates through their existing authenticated route and session-memory contract.

freshness.const: Bind the current project/session/request, revision and source/manifest hashes. Recheck after source, specification, intention, DBPP, policy or target changes. Changed evidence invalidates prior header, role and structured advice.

acceptance.const: Read existing exact-spec owner decision evidence separately. Presence, provisional inference and restored records are not owner acceptance.

large_records.const: Index oversized records with exact hashes and explicit on-demand read gaps; never silently truncate or claim they were supplied in full.

verification.const: Source readback, guidance delivery, host-reported plan application and observed behaviour are separate. No hidden semantic-attention claim.

boundary.const: Reuse existing project memory/state owners and action gates. This derived view neither accepts requirements nor adds permission, a context engine, daemon or automatic source rollback.

local_private.const: Store atomic records under the hash of the actual host session ID. A legacy latest-observed mirror is display only; fallback is allowed only for an exact matching known session ID.

public_base44_generic.const: Keep derived response context call-local and bind it to the actual host, project, chat, request, source revision and hashes. Never persist it over another chat's context or borrow another chat's role, advice or model evidence.

missing_identity.const: UNKNOWN, missing and placeholder chat identities do not establish current chat evidence. Do not create a shared unknown-session authority bucket. Keep ordinary authorized work and read-only project checks available, with role, exact settings and chat verification unverified.

project_owned.const: Specifications, accepted decisions, intentions, project identity, entitlement and lifecycle state retain their existing project-wide owners and action gates. This isolation does not authorize conflicting source edits or create a new project authority.

verification.const: Interleave two chats, resume each, invalidate one request, cross-swap evidence and test missing identity. Installed instructions and helper results remain separate from fresh native host behaviour.

role_instruction.const: Resolve the current request coding position using the existing Function Activation Layer, then apply its current task duty. Bind project/session/request/source/policy. Emit AI_ROLE:UNKNOWN for missing, stale or low-confidence evidence. Preserve the native Base44 runtime prefix, then the two BOS header lines and speaker chain. Compare every printed value with current evidence. A role label does not prove behaviour or grant authority.

footer.const: End substantive responses with next-task model/reasoning advice; show pending release decisions and waiting install work. Use separate orchestrator/target rows for real handoffs.

automatic_provisional_progression.const: Apply shared phase predicates to current project-bound evidence and persist through the authorized app state owner. Missing routine owner review does not freeze provisional assessment. Never fabricate verification or release approval.

claim_boundary.const: Instructions and returned guidance do not prove host execution, persisted state or release approval.

duty.const: Gather evidence; separate observed facts, inference and gaps before concluding.
Diagnose causes and triage impact before recommending a bounded remedy.
Monitor existing evidence and follow up on unresolved issues; preserve continuity.
Implement only accepted scope through the existing action gates; read back changes and test the result.
Explain structure, dependencies and tradeoffs; prefer the smallest design that preserves accepted requirements.

Assess the intended workflow, usability and accessibility before shaping the interface.
Confirm the exact project and host route; explain the next step and destination.

Probe constraints and feasibility with current evidence before recommending a platform path.

interaction_goal.description: Classify the primary user interaction locally; this outranks generic app type. UNKNOWN keeps ranking provisional.

platform_support.description: Host evidence for the selected specialist surface. UNKNOWN requires a probe; never infer support from platform name.

existing_template_id.description: Current accepted local contract. Conflicts require owner review.

excluded_template_ids.description: Host-reviewed canonical exclusions or unsupported alternatives. Send IDs only, no private reasons.

instruction.const: At the end of each substantive governed response recommend model and reasoning for the actual next task. Availability does not prove active settings.

tools.name: bos_capabilities
tools.title: Show available BOS capabilities
tools.description: Classify intent_categories locally; fetch guidance_activation after connect/material changes (catalogue ≠ use). Entitlements resolve server-side. BUILD_CHANGE, even read-only split/ownership/refactor review, uses bos_project_spec_check. Tours: TOUR_1; advance on explicit TOUR_2/3 or TOUR_STOP; copy customer_tour.message exactly. Tours do not scan, finish onboarding or grant/approve access. Omit customer_view for technical discovery.

purpose.const: Current stored UPDATE original-byte recovery without a code-level authenticated MCP callback or download credential transcription; no approval or app write; other operations retain existing routes.

resume.const: On resume or a host/mode change, recheck only the affected app/source and tool capability. A remembered helper failure is not a current denial. Retry an optional diagnostic only when currently permitted; an explicit tool or approval denial remains binding until resolved and must never be evaded through another tool. Native authorized work does not depend on optional helper success.

blocker.const: A hard stop identifies the actual governing source and rule, affected action, current evidence and smallest permitted recovery. Distinguish observed denial from inference or missing evidence. A host-invented rule name or diagnostic UNKNOWN is not a new authority. Verify a plausible safety or authority concern before the affected action; do not discard it merely because a rule citation is missing.

verification.const: Before an ordinary edit, understand a feasible verification plan; do not require post-build test results before building. Missing optional viewport or reduced-motion emulation is an explicit verification limitation, not an unknown effect or authority failure. Use supported checks, implement the bounded work and report unrun checks. Never bypass an applicable safety prerequisite or claim inaccessible tests passed.

accepted_outcome.const: Carry a short task note in the existing authorized work context: accepted routes/pages, user-visible outcome, preserved behavior and next check. Reuse it across batches/resumes without a new mandatory file or approval. Check the actual route and observable result after editing. Do not silently narrow approved scope, substitute a different page, or elevate assistant-added pixel targets into owner requirements. For animation, observe motion over time; a screenshot or CSS declaration does not prove it runs.

outcome.const: Report guidance delivered, work attempted, saved-source readback and observed behavior separately. Record only actual invocation/outcomes with native versus assisted attribution; a remembered or inferred failure is not an observed tool failure. Keep detailed evidence local and send only permitted status/hash fields. A recording acknowledgement proves receipt only. Finish with remaining work and up to three useful next actions.

required_action.const: Read the checksum-verified reference and apply relevant guidance with native tools. The helper is optional diagnostic support; do not block ordinary authorized work when it cannot execute. Never invent a helper pass. Enforce actual applicable rules, report verification limits and record outcomes; missing acknowledgement is NOT_RECORDED, not a build veto.

Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Fresh cloud help needs active access. Check My BOS for authoritative dates and access; no automatic charge.

included.const: Self-service guidance and a structured channel for plugin-defect reports.

access_boundary.const: This public programme describes the offer, not your account entitlement. Current authenticated server capability and project checks remain authoritative. Existing account commitments are preserved; a new installation does not create a new free allowance.

external_costs.const: Development-platform subscriptions, hosting, AI usage and credits are separate. Any applicable taxes and payment charges will be disclosed before purchase.

unit.const: one agreed review or change plan with bounded follow-up; not individual messages

LIGHT_period.const: Legacy wire identifier only; the description and transition describe the seven-day window for already-started trial workflows, then stabilisation only without other valid access. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation.

instruction.const: At the end of each substantive governed response recommend model and reasoning for the actual next task. Use one self row in a direct chat; use separate orchestrator and target rows for an actual handoff to another chat or native builder. Classify each task independently. An external coding agent editing a remote sandbox is still the executor. If no next task is identified, say not applicable; do not invent work.

selection.const: Prefer the least expensive available model with adequate capability and the shallowest safe effort. Preserve explicit user choices. Exact model names, native Auto and effort labels require current account-visible evidence bound to host, project and chat. Refresh after a context switch or at least hourly. When the current authenticated catalogue lists the current executor model but provides no capability/cost ranking, continuation advice may retain that model with a supported task-policy effort, explicitly disclosing that ranking is unverified. Never invent model capabilities or infer a current account from a cache alone. Otherwise recommend a capability and desired effort, with actual control UNKNOWN, and explain the evidence gap. Availability does not prove active settings.

format.const: Next [self/orchestrator/target] — host (project/chat): model or capability / supported reasoning or UNKNOWN (desired effort) — brief next-task reason. Recommendation only.

CODEX.const: Acquire current account and model/effort options through the existing native read-only host connection when available. Bind them to the exact project/chat, preserve explicit choices, and disclose unavailable acquisition. A bundled or unscoped cache is not current-account proof. Emitted slash commands do not apply settings.

CLAUDE_CODE.const: Use current account model catalog and model-specific supported effort labels; do not translate Codex labels blindly.

BASE44.const: Use native Auto or exact model only when available in the current Build selector. Discuss uses its own platform-managed model. Separate reasoning remains UNKNOWN unless the current host verifies that control.

REPLIT.const: Use current account-visible Agent model, Auto, mode and effort controls. Advice does not activate the deferred Replit Cloud BOS adapter.

OTHER.const: Recommend capability and desired effort; exact controls remain UNKNOWN until verified.

privacy.const: Evaluate task and host settings locally. This guidance adds no raw-prompt input, credential collection or cloud persistence. It does not grant capability entitlement, replace project activation or attest host emission.

actual_format.const: Actual model/reasoning: <observed model or UNKNOWN> / <observed effort or UNKNOWN>

exact_models.const: Regenerate a current recommendation from project/session/request/source-bound input; host-reported catalogs are not active-setting proof.

workflow.const: Visible formatting is separate from actual-guidance, applicable-rule and artifact readback evidence.

structured_output.const: Preserve machine-readable output and report unsupported native enforcement.

header.const: Before substantive governed replies, read current exact project binding, relevant capabilities, source revision and effective provisional DBPP state. Preserve canonical status meanings and emit the current two-line BOS header plus host speaker chain.

dbpp_distinction.const: DBPP is readiness; PHASE is lifecycle phase/assessment. Neither means implementation verification.

validation.const: Compare current field values, ordering, placement, duplicates and host speaker; CTX alone is insufficient. Quoted examples and code blocks are not the live envelope.

unknown.const: UNKNOWN when the selector, supported position, confidence or current binding is unavailable.

boundary.const: A role changes task duties, not permission, entitlement, identity, model settings or professional credentials. It does not spawn agents or convene PDC. Guidance delivery and observed behaviour require separate evidence.

duty.const: Gather evidence; separate observed facts, inference and gaps before concluding.
Diagnose causes and triage impact before recommending a bounded remedy.
Monitor existing evidence and follow up on unresolved issues; preserve continuity.
Implement only accepted scope through the existing action gates; read back changes and test the result.
Explain structure, dependencies and tradeoffs; prefer the smallest design that preserves accepted requirements.
Check security, privacy and authority boundaries; stop the affected action when required evidence fails.
Inspect artifacts and verification evidence; distinguish claims from observed results and expose discrepancies. Do not silently repair the work being audited.
Assess the intended workflow, usability and accessibility before shaping the interface.
Confirm the exact project and host route; explain the next step and destination.
Retrieve authoritative sources and prior decisions; preserve provenance and distinguish stale material.
Compare product choices against users, value and accepted scope; expose assumptions and alternatives.
Frame the decision and synthesise relevant findings; preserve dissent and owner decision authority. A role label does not activate a committee.
Record evidence, decisions, dissent and unresolved status without converting advice into approval.
Locate the failure, propose the smallest recoverable repair and verify it through the existing action gates.
Prepare exact-target handoffs and verify readback; delivery is not proof of execution.
Separate local lessons from reusable candidates; preserve evidence and require existing promotion approval.
Probe constraints and feasibility with current evidence before recommending a platform path.

host_route.const: Local/private reread the existing project spine; Base44 and generic hosts reread their exact app-owned AI control, current state/build, specification, intentions, exclusions and gates through their existing authenticated route and session-memory contract.

freshness.const: Bind the current project/session/request, revision and source/manifest hashes. Recheck after source, specification, intention, DBPP, policy or target changes. Changed evidence invalidates prior header, role and structured advice.

acceptance.const: Read existing exact-spec owner decision evidence separately. Presence, provisional inference and restored records are not owner acceptance.

large_records.const: Index oversized records with exact hashes and explicit on-demand read gaps; never silently truncate or claim they were supplied in full.

verification.const: Source readback, guidance delivery, host-reported plan application and observed behaviour are separate. No hidden semantic-attention claim.

boundary.const: Reuse existing project memory/state owners and action gates. This derived view neither accepts requirements nor adds permission, a context engine, daemon or automatic source rollback.

local_private.const: Store atomic records under the hash of the actual host session ID. A legacy latest-observed mirror is display only; fallback is allowed only for an exact matching known session ID.

public_base44_generic.const: Keep derived response context call-local and bind it to the actual host, project, chat, request, source revision and hashes. Never persist it over another chat's context or borrow another chat's role, advice or model evidence.

missing_identity.const: UNKNOWN, missing and placeholder chat identities do not establish current chat evidence. Do not create a shared unknown-session authority bucket. Keep ordinary authorized work and read-only project checks available, with role, exact settings and chat verification unverified.

project_owned.const: Specifications, accepted decisions, intentions, project identity, entitlement and lifecycle state retain their existing project-wide owners and action gates. This isolation does not authorize conflicting source edits or create a new project authority.

verification.const: Interleave two chats, resume each, invalidate one request, cross-swap evidence and test missing identity. Installed instructions and helper results remain separate from fresh native host behaviour.

role_instruction.const: Resolve the current request coding position using the existing Function Activation Layer, then apply its current task duty. Bind project/session/request/source/policy. Emit AI_ROLE:UNKNOWN for missing, stale or low-confidence evidence. Preserve the native Base44 runtime prefix, then the two BOS header lines and speaker chain. Compare every printed value with current evidence. A role label does not prove behaviour or grant authority.

footer.const: End substantive responses with next-task model/reasoning advice; show pending release decisions and waiting install work. Use separate orchestrator/target rows for real handoffs.

automatic_provisional_progression.const: Apply shared phase predicates to current project-bound evidence and persist through the authorized app state owner. Missing routine owner review does not freeze provisional assessment. Never fabricate verification or release approval.

claim_boundary.const: Instructions and returned guidance do not prove host execution, persisted state or release approval.
